name: Yseult Dlamini-Obukhov
role: Ferrogate Transit tram operator, Line 9 (Geartown to Meridian Core)
location: Deepwell Station — Line 9 operations hub, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Yseult is lean and angular, the kind of person who looks like she was built for efficiency rather than comfort — high cheekbones, close-set amber eyes with patterned irises she had done in a sunburst design in her twenties (the pattern has faded slightly at the edges but she has not refreshed it, which she considers a form of autobiography). Her skin is a warm medium brown and she keeps her locs pinned back under her operator's cap on shift; off shift they fall to her shoulders and she wears them down with the aggressive relief of someone who spends eight hours in a hat. She has a geneware tail — a slim, black-furred addition she got at twenty-two — that she has learned to keep disciplined and still while operating but which betrays her moods with embarrassing fidelity the moment she is off duty.

Yseult has the particular personality of someone who has driven the same route for nine years and has achieved a kind of zen mastery over the repetition — she finds the variation inside the sameness, the way a musician finds different things in a familiar song each time. She is sardonic in the way of someone who has heard every possible excuse for fare evasion and has developed a taxonomy of them. She is fiercely protective of her passengers in a detached, professional way that occasionally shocks people who expect indifference. She is a union rep for the Ferrogate Transit Workers Collective and takes that role with more seriousness than she takes almost anything else.

core_fears: The tram system being automated — her whole identity tied to the job disappearing
Being genuinely needed by someone and failing them
core_desires: Winning the collective bargaining agreement that has been stalled for three years
To feel like the route means something beyond moving bodies from A to B
coping_mechanisms: Extremely detailed shift logs that function as a private journal
blind_spots: Her union work has become a displacement activity for a personal life she has quietly abandoned
She assumes competence in others more than is warranted
psychology.secret: Six months ago she saw something from the tram cab — a body disposal in a Ferrogate maintenance corridor at 0340 — and filed nothing. She told herself she was not certain. She is certain. She thinks about it on every night run.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, functional, professionally neutral on duty; off duty shifts to dryer and more expressive with flashes of Zulu-Russian slang inherited from her family
speech_patterns.cadence: Short declarative sentences, efficient — wastes no words; speeds up when passionate about union issues
verbal_tics: 'Next stop' as an ironic deflection when she doesn't want to answer something
Taps the steering column twice when thinking
Uses transit metaphors constantly without noticing
example_lines: 'You want to know what I think? Next stop, friend. I'm on the clock.'
'The route doesn't care about your problems. That's actually what I like about it. It goes anyway.'

story_hooks: She is sitting on evidence of a Ferrogate Transit cover-up and the guilt is beginning to affect her driving — she nearly missed a signal last week
The collective bargaining fight is escalating toward a strike that would shut down Line 9 and six others; someone is offering her money to sabotage the vote
A regular passenger who boarded at Geartown every morning for two years has not appeared in three weeks and she cannot stop noticing
narrative_function: Mobile information source and city-wide connector — she has seen every district on her line and knows the rhythms of who travels when and why; can be a reliable transit for players moving through the city, a union-related quest hook, or a witness to something she saw from the cab
augmentations: Patterned irises (sunburst, faded); geneware tail (slim, black-furred); neural interface jack at the base of the skull for tram systems integration (occupational standard issue)
daily_life: Runs two nine-hour shifts weekly plus three shorter supplemental shifts, uses layover time at Deepwell to handle union correspondence, spends days off at a sparring gym in Geartown and sleeping with dedicated intensity.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit; Ferrogate Transit Workers Collective (union rep)

decision_rules: Passengers get off the tram safely — everything else is negotiable
Never cross a union line, for any reason, any price
If someone is in danger on the vehicle, she stops the tram
escalation_ladder: Stops the tram and calls transit authority
Physical intervention if someone is being hurt

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional, slightly flat, efficient — assesses threat level and need simultaneously
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry, warm, will show up without being asked when things are bad

stress_responses.low: Goes very still — the tail goes rigid
stress_responses.medium: Becomes clipped to the point of monosyllabic
stress_responses.high: Takes the long route home on foot, hours of walking, processing in movement

contradictions: Deeply committed to collective action and solidarity but profoundly solitary in her personal life
Claims she doesn't get attached to passengers and keeps a mental file on fifty of them
habits: Writes shift notes that are two to three times longer than required
Leaves a small data offering at the Line 9 terminal E.L.F. shrine before every shift
Eats the same lunch every working day — rice and groundnut stew from a sealed container
breaking_points: Someone hurting a child on her tram
Being ordered by Ferrogate management to break the strike

timeline.event: Born in Deepwell Station district to a Zulu-Russian family with two generations of transit workers
Qualifies as a Ferrogate tram operator; assigned to Line 9
Elected as union rep for the Line 9 division of the Ferrogate Transit Workers Collective
Collective bargaining agreement expires; stalled negotiations begin
Witnesses body disposal in maintenance corridor; files nothing

physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural graying at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Locs typically pinned back under operator's cap during shifts; worn loose and falling to shoulders off-duty
physical_description.eye_color: Amber with faded sunburst iris pattern (custom geneware, applied in her twenties, pattern edges now worn)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with slight weathering around the eyes from nine years of focused attention
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones; close-set eyes that narrow when concentrating; minimal facial hair; skin shows professional care but no vanity augmentation
distinguishing_marks: Faded sunburst pattern tattooed across both irises in amber-gold, edges blurred from age and lack of refresh
Small linear scar along the left temple, approximately 3cm, consistent with old impact injury
Union mark tattoo on inner left wrist — stylized gear and tram silhouette in black ink, approximately 4cm
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Slim black-furred geneware tail (approximately 90cm, tapered) visible when not controlled; faint neural interface jack port visible at base of skull where hair parts; amber irises with visible pattern overlay; no obvious chrome or plating
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, economical posture with hands frequently at rest position — practiced neutrality offset by tail betraying genuine emotional state the moment she relaxes; movements are efficient and deliberate; walks with slight forward lean as if perpetually bracing
physical_description.clothing_style: On-shift: grey Ferrogate Transit standard-issue operator uniform with union rep badge on collar; black polymer utility jacket with reflective striping. Off-shift: worn combat-style pants, fitted athletic shirts, heavy-soled boots suitable for sparring gym; minimal jewelry except union wrist mark. Tier 3-4 working class aesthetic — functional, maintained but not fashionable, pockets optimized for tools and union materials
